en.cardTitle: Pa11y Batch: bulk WCAG audits in Spanish with CI/CD
en.cardDesc: Web Studio suite, CLI and CI/CD for automated accessibility audits with axe-core and HTML_CodeSniffer in Spanish, executive Stakeholder view, visual DOM inspection and JUnit artifacts.

articles.article8-p1: Auditing one URL is easy; auditing five hundred with traceability is another matter. Pa11y Batch was built to scale automated audits: it runs axe-core and HTML_CodeSniffer over entire batches of URLs and consolidates results into Spanish-language reports aimed at both technical staff and management.
articles.article8-p2: Each URL is evaluated independently by axe-core and HTML_CodeSniffer. Running two engines reduces false negatives and lets you cross-check criteria when rules overlap: if both flag the same element, confidence in the finding increases; if they diverge, the human auditor decides with context.
articles.article8-p3: The report includes an aggregated view aimed at non-technical profiles: conformance trend by WCAG level, severity distribution and evolution between runs. Alongside it, the technical view offers visual DOM inspection with screenshots and precise selectors for each violation.
articles.article8-p4: The suite emits reports in JUnit XML format, the standard understood by Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps. This turns accessibility into a quality gate: the pipeline fails if violations appear above the configured threshold.
articles.article8-p5: On top of the CLI engine sits Pa11y Batch Web Studio, a web interface to launch audits without a terminal. One of its differentiators is that findings, rule descriptions and recommendations are delivered entirely in Spanish, something the original tools do not offer.
articles.article8-p6: The project is open source and available at github.com/ingelectronicadj/pa11y_batch.
